attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

topics.who: Prescription opioid drugs, incl. risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction and diversion

rules.notes: 20 credit hours per biennial renewal period: at least 17 in surgery, medicine or dentistry, max 4 in business management, 1 on prescription opioids (since the period beginning June 30, 2019). Licenses renew every two years.
rules.rule_quote: (b) Each applicant for biennial license renewal shall complete 20 credit hours of continuing education in the preceding biennial license period.
